```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(recipes)
library(forcats)
library(yardstick)
library(beepr)
```

### Data prep and split
```{r}
#load dataset:
#150cm:
pedon_pack_150_p <- read.csv("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_02_26_26.csv")

set.seed(1)

df <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxorder = factor(taxorder)
  )

# lump rare orders to avoid dropped-level issues in resampling
min_n <- 15
df <- df %>%
  mutate(taxorder = fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = min_n, other_level = "Other"))
#there is only 4 lol...
count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

df <- df %>% filter(taxorder != "Other")
df <- df %>% droplevels()
count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
```

### Helpers:

```{r}
#XGBOOST
# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

drop_bad_predictors <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid", drop_cols = NULL) {
  train_df <- train_df %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  
  # logical -> integer
  train_df <- train_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  
  # drop leftover character predictors except id/outcome
  char_preds <- names(train_df)[vapply(train_df, is.character, logical(1))]
  char_preds <- setdiff(char_preds, c(id_col, outcome))
  
  if (length(char_preds) > 0) {
    cat("\nDropping remaining character predictors:\n")
    print(char_preds)
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
  }
  
  # drop one-value predictors based on training set
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), c(id_col, outcome))
  
  one_val <- pred_names[
    vapply(train_df[pred_names], function(x) {
      length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1
    }, logical(1))
  ]
  
  if (length(one_val) > 0) {
    cat("\nDropping one-value predictors:\n")
    print(one_val)
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
  }
  
  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}


confidence_summary_tbl <- function(pred_tbl, model_name = "model") {
  pred_tbl %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs  = list(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$"))),
      top1   = max(probs),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(
      model          = model_name,
      mean_top1      = mean(top1, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_top1   = mean(top1 < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_margin    = mean(margin, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_margin = mean(margin < 0.15, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}


metric_extract_tbl <- function(pred_tbl, outcome, model_name) {
  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)
  
  met <- metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
    pred_tbl,
    truth = !!outcome_sym,
    estimate = .pred_class
  )
  
  f1 <- f_meas(
    pred_tbl,
    truth = !!outcome_sym,
    estimate = .pred_class,
    estimator = "macro"
  )
  
  conf <- confidence_summary_tbl(pred_tbl, model_name)
  
  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    accuracy = met$.estimate[met$.metric == "accuracy"],
    kap = met$.estimate[met$.metric == "kap"],
    bal_accuracy = met$.estimate[met$.metric == "bal_accuracy"],
    f_meas_macro = f1$.estimate,
    mean_top1 = conf$mean_top1,
    pct_low_top1 = conf$pct_low_top1,
    mean_margin = conf$mean_margin,
    pct_low_margin = conf$pct_low_margin
  )
}


fit_xgb_direct <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid",
                           grid_size = 25,
                           metric_for_best = "bal_accuracy",
                           trees_range = c(500L, 2500L),
                           seed_base = 1) {
  
  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)
  
  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")), data = train_df) %>%
    update_role(all_of(id_col), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df, retain = TRUE)
  
  x_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(outcome, id_col)))
  
  x_test <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test_df) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(outcome, id_col)))
  
  p <- ncol(x_train)
  if (p < 1) stop("No usable predictor columns remain.")
  
  min_class_n <- train_df %>%
    count(!!outcome_sym) %>%
    summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
    pull(min_n)
  
  v <- min(5, min_class_n)
  if (v < 2) stop("At least one class has <2 training samples.")
  
  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune(),
    stop_iter = 25
  ) %>%
    set_engine("xgboost") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(xgb_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)
  
  set.seed(seed_base + 1)
  folds <- vfold_cv(train_df, v = v, strata = !!outcome_sym)
  
  xgb_params <- parameters(
    trees(range = trees_range),
    tree_depth(range = c(2L, 8L)),
    learn_rate(range = c(-3, -0.5)),
    loss_reduction(range = c(-3, 1)),
    min_n(range = c(2L, 20L)),
    sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0)),
    finalize(mtry(), x_train)
  )
  
  set.seed(seed_base + 2)
  grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
    xgb_params,
    size = grid_size
  )
  
  set.seed(seed_base + 3)
  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid,
    metrics = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap, accuracy)
  )
  
  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = metric_for_best)
  
  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>%
    fit(train_df)
  
  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_df %>% select(all_of(outcome)))
  
  pred_conf <- pred %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs = list(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$"))),
      top1   = max(probs),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  xgb_fit_obj <- final_fit %>%
    extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
    purrr::pluck("fit")
  
  importance <- xgboost::xgb.importance(
    feature_names = names(x_train),
    model = xgb_fit_obj
  )
  
  list(
    recipe = rec,
    prep = prep_rec,
    x_train = x_train,
    x_test = x_test,
    tuned = tuned,
    best = best,
    final_fit = final_fit,
    xgb_fit_obj = xgb_fit_obj,
    pred = pred_conf,
    conf_mat = conf_mat(pred_conf, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class),
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
      pred_conf, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class
    ),
    f_meas = f_meas(
      pred_conf, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"
    ),
    importance = importance
  )
}


report_xgb_results <- function(res, outcome, label, top_n = 20) {
  cat("\n=== ", label, " BEST XGBOOST SETTINGS ===\n", sep = "")
  print(res$best)
  
  cat("\n=== ", label, " FINAL METRICS ===\n", sep = "")
  print(res$metrics)
  print(res$f_meas)
  
  cat("\n=== ", label, " CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n", sep = "")
  print(res$conf_mat)
  
  cat("\n=== ", label, " CONFUSION MATRIX SUMMARY ===\n", sep = "")
  print(summary(res$conf_mat))
  
  cat("\n=== ", label, " TOP ", top_n, " XGBOOST PREDICTORS (GAIN) ===\n", sep = "")
  print(res$importance %>% as_tibble() %>% slice_max(Gain, n = top_n))
  
  cat("\n=== ", label, " CONFIDENCE ===\n", sep = "")
  print(confidence_summary_tbl(res$pred, label))
}


plot_xgb_vip <- function(res, top_n = 20, title = NULL) {
  p <- vip::vip(res$xgb_fit_obj, num_features = top_n)
  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + ggplot2::labs(title = title)
  p
}


plot_xgb_gain <- function(res, top_n = 20, measure = "Gain", title = NULL) {
  p <- xgboost::xgb.ggplot.importance(
    importance_matrix = res$importance,
    top_n = top_n,
    measure = measure
  )
  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + ggplot2::labs(title = title)
  p
}
```

### Taxorder

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TAXORDER: PLAIN XGBOOST (NO UMAP)
# ============================================================

set.seed(1)

min_n_order <- 15

df_order <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxorder = factor(taxorder)
  ) %>%
  mutate(taxorder = forcats::fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = min_n_order, other_level = "Other")) %>%
  filter(taxorder != "Other") %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\n=== TAXORDER COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(df_order, taxorder, sort = TRUE))

split_order <- initial_split(df_order, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train_order <- training(split_order)
test_order  <- testing(split_order)

clean_order <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df = train_order,
  test_df  = test_order,
  outcome  = "taxorder",
  id_col   = "peiid",
  drop_cols = c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize"
  )
)

res_order_xgb <- fit_xgb_direct(
  train_df = clean_order$train,
  test_df  = clean_order$test,
  outcome  = "taxorder",
  id_col   = "peiid",
  grid_size = 25,
  seed_base = 100
)

report_xgb_results(res_order_xgb, "taxorder", "TAXORDER XGB", top_n = 20)

plot_xgb_vip(res_order_xgb, top_n = 20, title = "Taxorder XGBoost VIP")
plot_xgb_gain(res_order_xgb, top_n = 20, title = "Taxorder XGBoost Gain Importance")

beepr::beep("wilhelm")
```

### Taxsubgrp1

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SUBGROUP MODIFIER 1: PLAIN XGBOOST (NO UMAP)
# ============================================================

set.seed(21)

min_n_mod1 <- 8

df_mod1 <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = str_squish(as.character(taxsubgrp_mod1)),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = na_if(taxsubgrp_mod1, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  add_count(taxsubgrp_mod1, name = "class_n") %>%
  filter(class_n >= min_n_mod1) %>%
  select(-class_n) %>%
  mutate(taxsubgrp_mod1 = factor(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  droplevels()

split_mod1 <- initial_split(df_mod1, prop = 0.8, strata = taxsubgrp_mod1)
train_mod1 <- training(split_mod1)
test_mod1  <- testing(split_mod1)

clean_mod1 <- drop_bad_predictors(
  train_df = train_mod1,
  test_df  = test_mod1,
  outcome  = "taxsubgrp_mod1",
  id_col   = "peiid",
  drop_cols = c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
    "taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3"
  )
)

res_mod1_xgb <- fit_xgb_direct(
  train_df = clean_mod1$train,
  test_df  = clean_mod1$test,
  outcome  = "taxsubgrp_mod1",
  id_col   = "peiid",

)

report_xgb_results(res_mod1_xgb, "taxsubgrp_mod1", "MOD1 XGB", top_n = 20)

plot_xgb_vip(res_mod1_xgb, top_n = 20, title = "Subgroup Modifier 1 XGBoost VIP")
plot_xgb_gain(res_mod1_xgb, top_n = 20, title = "Subgroup Modifier 1 XGBoost Gain Importance")
```

### Summary


```{r}
# ============================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================

xgb_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  metric_extract_tbl(res_order_xgb$pred, "taxorder", "taxorder_xgb"),
  metric_extract_tbl(res_so_xgb$pred, "taxsuborder", "taxsuborder_xgb"),
  metric_extract_tbl(res_gg_xgb$pred, "taxgrtgroup", "greatgroup_xgb"),
  metric_extract_tbl(res_mod1_xgb$pred, "taxsubgrp_mod1", "mod1_xgb"),
  metric_extract_tbl(res_ps_xgb$pred, "taxpartsize", "taxpartsize_xgb")
) %>%
  arrange(desc(bal_accuracy), desc(f_meas_macro), desc(accuracy))

cat("\n=== XGBOOST SUMMARY ACROSS TAXA ===\n")
print(xgb_summary_all)

#Tuned XGBoost models showed strong variation in predictive performance across taxonomic levels. Taxsuborder was the most predictable target (accuracy = 0.947, balanced accuracy = 0.946, macro F1 = 0.895), followed by taxorder (accuracy = 0.892, balanced accuracy = 0.814). Great group prediction was moderate but still substantial (accuracy = 0.729, balanced accuracy = 0.805, macro F1 = 0.693), indicating that profile-derived predictors retained useful information at finer taxonomic levels. Performance declined further for subgroup modifier 1 and tax particle-size class, suggesting that these targets were more difficult to distinguish from the available predictor set and were more affected by class overlap and imbalance.
```
